grh_f8e897f04d941ce62a8d.title: The Other One
paragraphs: Edward lies to police to protect his troubled brother Randolph, who is suspected in the death of schoolgirl Miriam Winslow. Dr. Christian patiently works past Edwards fierce family loyalty and uncovers a pattern of theft, secret spending and desperate attempts by Randolph to impress Miriam. Edward finally admits that Randolph met the girl wearing a hidden new jacket, tried to force an expensive necklace on her, and killed her when the encounter turned violent. Dr. Christian helps Edward understand that protecting his brother with lies will only deepen the damage, and that telling the truth is the only way to help both Randolph and their family.
